title: SMB specific settings not working
symptom: SMB specific config settings are not being respected. SMB is delivered even when no carbs are present and beyond the configured 6 hours after carbs, and also with high temp targets when 'no carbs for high temp' is set.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user speculates it may be related to merging DynISF directly in rather than leaving it as a plugin, possibly the combination of DynISF plus SMB settings.
fix: No resolution is provided. The thread ends with a request for a screenshot from the SMB tab and is closed for inactivity.
